reviews.comment:
la atencion para cargar nafta a la noche es malisima, te atienden con la peor de las ondas siempre esta el mismo hombre cargando, no tiene paciencia para explicarte algo si no entendiste, aunque lo trates con respeto te contesta mal.
A la tarde son mas simpáticos y la chica que atiende en el bar, muy amable y buena onda.

(Translated by Google)
The service at the gas station at night is terrible. The staff is incredibly rude, and it's always the same man pumping the gas. He has no patience to explain anything if you don't understand, and even if you treat him respectfully, he'll still be rude.
In the afternoon, they're much friendlier, and the woman who works at the bar is very kind and helpful.
